App 所在資料分割區。: Data partition used by the app.

系統／廠商標示的感測器資訊，不代表已通過硬體檢測；數值單位依感測器類型。: Sensor information reported by Android or the vendor. Units depend on the sensor type.
寬高與幀率範圍分列，不代表所有組合可同時使用。: Dimension and frame rate ranges are reported separately. Supported combinations may vary.
僅代表這個 DRM 方案的公開支援查詢結果。: Result of the public support query for this DRM scheme.
不代表任何串流服務保證提供特定畫質。: Streaming resolution depends on the provider.
可用系統 RAM，包含可回收部分。: Available system RAM, including reclaimable memory.
系統低記憶體判定門檻，不是剩餘量。: Threshold used by Android to identify low memory.
可選唯讀來源；休眠核心或 SELinux 限制時未知: Optional read-only source. A sleeping core or SELinux restrictions can prevent reads.
剩餘能量與剩餘電荷比，非瞬時實測電壓；不依電量百分比猜測。: Estimated from remaining energy and remaining charge.
僅在來源電壓 6–10 V 且手動開啟雙電芯模式時顯示；假設為兩芯串聯，不代表接: Shown for reported voltages from 6 to 10 V when dual-cell mode is enabled. Assumes two cells in series.
保留系統原始回報；0 未經其他來源交叉驗證，不代表已確認電池從未循環。: A reported zero has not been verified against another source.
來源未提供 latest；無法判定更新: The source did not report a latest version. Update status is unavailable.
Samsung 官方更新紀錄頁首筆: First entry on Samsung's official update history page
型號格式應為 SM-S9280；請勿加 /DS: Enter a model such as SM-S9280 without /DS.
CSC 必須是 3 位英數代碼，例如 BRI、TGY、EUX: Enter a three-character CSC such as BRI, TGY, or EUX.
未在可辨識的電池區段找到此欄位。: This field was absent from the recognized battery section.
來源明確回報未提供此欄位；保留原始依據。: The source reported this field as unavailable. Raw evidence is retained.
來源回報的格式、範圍或數值無效；保留原始依據。: The source reported an invalid format, range, or value. Raw evidence is retained.
同欄位包含不同電池／報告值，或有效與無效回報；不選第一筆、不平均。: The field contains conflicting or invalid readings. All evidence is retained.
廠商原始欄位；不除以 100 換算成循環次數。: Raw vendor field. Its units are unverified.
來源明確列出的循環次數，為報告當時的快照。: Cycle count reported at the time of the snapshot.
公開規格，非本機逐核心量測。公版時脈／快取可能因細分版本不同；本機頻率、ABI: Published specifications. Reference clocks and cache sizes may vary by variant. Device frequencies, ABIs, and CPU flags are listed separately.
優先對照完整型號，缺少時使用同品牌的內部代號；多個市售名稱衝突時保留未知。不是使: The exact model number takes priority. The device codename can help when the model is absent. Conflicting names are left unresolved.
此為完整型號的發售版本，不代表目前位置、SIM 國家或作用中 CSC。: Release market of this model. Current location, SIM country, and active CSC can differ.
不同地區、電信商與硬體版本分開收錄；此為公開規格參考，不覆蓋本機讀值。市場標示不: Published specifications are listed by region, carrier, and hardware variant. Device readings take priority.
來源有衝突，保留優先的本機硬體回報。: Reports conflict. The highest-priority on-device report is shown.
優先本機硬體資料，無法辨識時採完整型號或唯一內部代號的公開規格；不是本機實測規格: On-device data takes priority. Published specs are used when an exact model or unique codename can be matched.
CPU 品牌或架構的公開規格，非本機逐核心量測。: Published CPU brand or architecture specifications.
未知或空白也可能代表系統沒有提供 32 位元 App 支援。: An empty value may indicate that Android does not support 32-bit apps.
目前 App 程序的執行模式。: Bitness of the current app process.
驅動實際回報名稱；ANGLE 或軟體 renderer 會如實顯示，不以晶片規格: Renderer reported by the driver, including ANGLE or a software renderer when present.
公開晶片規格，非本機正在使用的 GPU 或實際驅動回報；不覆蓋上方即時讀值。: Published GPU specifications. Live driver readings are listed separately.
離屏 GLES 2 Context 回報的驅動版本，不代表裝置最高支援版本。: Driver version reported by the offscreen GLES 2 context.
目前離屏 Context 的能力。: Supported by the current offscreen context.
目前 Context 的驅動回報，非所有 GLES 版本的完整能力。: Extensions reported by the driver for the current context.
系統宣告的需求支援上限，與目前建立的 Context 分列。: Maximum version declared by Android. The current context is listed separately.
一般 Android App 無通用公開 API: No general public API for regular Android apps
目前總量是可讀分割區；不由速度或容量猜 UFS 世代與廠商。: Capacity of the readable partition. Flash vendor and UFS generation are unverified.
核心公開旗標；未開放時未知，不由晶片名稱猜測。: CPU flags exposed by the kernel. Restricted flags are unavailable.
只顯示核心公開識別欄位；不含序號，不據此猜大小核心配置。: Shows public kernel identification fields, excluding serial numbers.
可選唯讀節點；不是即時頻率或保證持續頻率。: Optional read-only frequency limits. Actual sustained frequencies can differ.
Linux cpufreq 政策的核心編號，不從頻率猜大小核心架構。: Core numbers in the Linux cpufreq policy.
kHz → MHz；部分驅動不提供離散頻率表。: Converted from kHz to MHz. Some drivers omit the frequency table.
DRM 插件回報，非手機或面板製造商。: Vendor reported by the DRM plugin.
Widevine 插件自訂欄位原文；不是 Android 標準安全等級 API，: Raw Widevine security level reported by the plugin. Streaming quality depends on the provider.
裝置可用輸出介面的最高宣告能力，非目前連線或播放時的等級。: Highest HDCP level declared for available device outputs.
僅反映目前連線；沒有外接接收端時可能為未知或無。: Applies to the active connection. It may be unavailable without an external receiver.
來源代號有衝突；保留優先來源，未以裝置名稱覆蓋。: Chipset codes conflict. The highest-priority source is shown.
共用代號，無法確認細分版本。: This codename is shared across variants.
本機回報與規格參考不同；保留本機回報。: The device report takes priority when it disagrees with published specifications.
KGSL 驅動未取得測點時回傳 INT_MIN: The KGSL driver returns INT_MIN when its sensor reading is unavailable
公開 KGSL temp 契約為毫攝氏度；仍需本機 compatible 或機型: The KGSL interface uses millidegrees Celsius. The summary requires supporting driver or model evidence.
官方紀錄入口未提供可辨識的英文頁面: No recognizable English page was found in the official update history
官方更新紀錄格式未辨識；無法判定版本: Unrecognized official update history format. Version unavailable.
bcl-lvl 名稱是保護狀態類線索，尚未驗證狀態語意及物理單位；只顯示原始值。: The bcl-lvl name suggests a protection state. Its meaning and units are unverified.
實際來源是 trip_point_*_temp，屬核心介面門檻欄位，不是當前溫度: The kernel trip_point_*_temp field reports a threshold.
Android ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED 的 EXTRA_T: Android ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED reports EXTRA_TEMPERATURE in tenths of a degree Celsius.
驅動標籤符合 CPU 測點規則且來源有溫度單位定義；不確認實體位置，也不代表每核: The driver label and declared units identify a CPU temperature reading. Physical location and per-core coverage are unverified.
來源有溫度單位定義，驅動明確標示 SoC；不以 CPU、GPU、電池或其他測點替: The driver identifies this SoC sensor and reports its units. Temperatures can vary across the chip.
使用者 S26 Ultra 的 DevCheck 6.60 畫面（2026-10: The S26 Ultra's video thermal sensor is classified as SoC on supported models. The raw thermal reading is converted using the kernel ABI. Regional firmware support varies.
本機 GPU compatible 與 qcom,tzone-names 明確連: The device's GPU compatible property and qcom,tzone-names link this thermal sensor to the GPU. Converted using the thermal ABI.
驅動標籤及可讀 driver / compatible 綁定共同指向 GPU；依: Driver labels and bindings point to the GPU. Physical location is unverified.
GPU／KGSL 名稱及參考介面僅為線索；缺少本機驅動綁定或型號來源驗證，排除摘: GPU or KGSL naming is indirect evidence. Excluded from the summary until the device mapping is verified.
僅由驅動標籤辨識；詳細頁保留，摘要不替代或平均 Android 電池來源。: Identified by the driver label. The battery summary uses Android's battery report separately.
名稱及可讀設定不足以辨識用途；保留原文與原始值，不納入溫度摘要。: Purpose cannot be verified. The raw name and reading are available in details.
檔案系統明確回報的探索狀態；不推測感測器物理位置。: Discovery status reported by the filesystem.
thermal temp / trip_point_*_temp 依 ABI 為: The thermal ABI reports temp and trip_point_*_temp in millidegrees Celsius. Other nodes require verification.
Linux power_supply：µAh → mAh；驅動設計值或最近滿充門: Linux power_supply converts µAh to mAh. The driver may report capacity for an individual cell or the entire pack.
Linux power_supply：µWh → mWh，不與電荷容量混算。: Linux power_supply energy converted from µWh to mWh.
Linux power_supply 標準百分比；為驅動回報，不以容量比自行推算: Health percentage reported by the Linux driver. Calculation methods vary by vendor.
Samsung ASOC 原始值，非本 App 實測 SOH。: Raw Samsung ASOC reported by the device.
非標準廠商欄位，單位未確認；不除以 100 或當作實際循環次數。: Nonstandard vendor field with unverified units.
小米系候選欄位；單位及語意未由此機型驗證，只顯示原始值。: Raw Xiaomi field. Units and meaning have not been verified for this model.
標準 cycle_count 回報；0 代表來源沒有可用循環資訊，不當作已確認零: Standard cycle_count reading. A raw zero indicates that no usable count was reported.
devfreq：Hz → MHz；手動快照，非目前持續頻率或 GPU 使用率。: devfreq snapshot, converted from Hz to MHz.
KGSL busy / total 驅動取樣區間比，非 FPS。: KGSL busy time as a share of the driver's sampling interval.
使用已辨識 SoC 來源的有效最高測點；不代表整顆晶片的完整溫度。: Highest valid reading among identified SoC sensors. Temperatures can vary across the chip.
尚未辨識到可納入摘要的 SoC 來源，不代表手機沒有感測器。其他來源保留原名，未: No SoC sources are verified for the summary. Other sensor readings are listed under their original names.
系統回報的熱壓力等級，不代表已確認所有元件均未降頻。: Thermal stress level reported by Android. Individual components may still throttle.
系統對未來 10 秒的熱壓力預估，非溫度或剩餘百分比；1.0 對應嚴重熱壓力參考: Estimated thermal stress over the next 10 seconds. A value of 1.0 corresponds to severe thermal stress and can be exceeded.
顯示裝置識別碼，請勿公開分享: Shows device identifiers. Keep them private.
電壓、電量與溫度候選資訊: Reported voltage, charge level, and temperature where available
偵錯與日誌選項可能改動設定: Debugging and logging options may change settings
可能變更 USB／偵錯介面: May change USB or debugging interfaces
可能永久清除使用者資料與設定: May permanently erase user data and settings
可能清除使用者資料與應用程式: May erase user data and apps
